scene_summary: A coral-red expressionist plate holds a large skull-like cream face within a swept navy hair-and-shoulder mass on the left, a smaller detached bob-haired face at upper right, and a bent orange sleeve reaching toward a tall cream pigment wipe. The wipe runs through the full image height just right of center, with ragged turquoise and ochre-yellow traces; its lower section merges into a broad cream stroke extending to the right edge.
usable_surfaces: Tall ragged cream wipe with turquoise-yellow edge traces

detected_objects.label: Tall cream pigment wipe with ragged turquoise-yellow edges
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A substantial pale cream vertical drag occupies the strip just right of center, entering at the top edge and continuing to the bottom. Coral gaps and abrasions interrupt its pigment. Turquoise appears along the upper right edge, the left edge near one-third height, the mid-lower right edge, and the lower left edge; ochre-yellow traces sit alongside the cream. The polygon follows the tall wipe and its colored fringe rather than enclosing the adjoining orange sleeve or the full horizontal cream extension. This is the single mapped owning-source mark; the faces and sleeve remain subordinate composition.

complexity_assessment.rationale: The restricted coral, navy, cream and orange palette and open coral intervals keep the plate legible and expressionist. It is not strictly minimal: the large skull-like figure, smaller detached face, angular sleeve and branching cream wipe create four competing forms. Surface abrasion adds texture without making the scene too cluttered, and the sole mapped wipe remains clearly visible.
